workarounds.symptom: manage_dhcp_lease make-static fails with HTTP 400 "unknown parameter dynamic"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dhcp): run make-static instead of patching the read-only dynamic flag. Target files: src/domain/tools/dhcp-tools.ts, test/unit/domain/dhcp-tools.test.ts, CHANGELOG.md. `manage_dhcp_lease` with `action: "make-static"` converted the lease by patching it with `dynamic: "false"`. RouterOS treats `dynamic` as a read-only flag on `/ip/dhcp-server/lease`, so every real call failed with `HTTP 400 "unknown parameter dynamic"` and the lease stayed dynamic. The dry run never contacts the write path, so it looked fine. (Ref: https://github.com/AliKarami/MikroMCP/pull/159)

workarounds.symptom: HTTP 429: rate limit is undocumented and the response gives no budget or real retry time
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(http): say what the rate limit is when it answers 429. Target files: src/mcp/transports/http.ts, test/unit/transports/http-hardening.test.ts, CHANGELOG.md. The HTTP rate limit (60 requests per 60 seconds per client IP) answered `429` with fixed text, "Retry after 60 seconds", whatever was left of the fixed window. The response named no limit and carried no `Retry-After` header. The limit was described only as one row in the Configuration table, not where a user meets it. A script that makes one tool call per iteration ... (Ref: https://github.com/AliKarami/MikroMCP/pull/149)

workarounds.symptom: reboot tool fails on RouterOS 7.25: HTTP 400 unknown parameter delay
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(reboot): stop sending an unknown delay parameter to /system/reboot. Target files: src/domain/tools/system-ops-tools.ts, test/unit/domain/system-ops-tools.test.ts, CHANGELOG.md. `reboot` sent `{"delay": "<n>"}` to `/system/reboot`, which takes no arguments. RouterOS rejected every call with `HTTP 400: unknown parameter delay`, including `delay: 0`. Reproduced on RouterOS 7.23.2 as well as the reporter's 7.25. (Ref: https://github.com/AliKarami/MikroMCP/pull/132)

workarounds.symptom: SwOS on a CSS318 (full SwOS 2.19): wrong speeds, 100x uptime, empty VLAN members; factory login refused
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(swos): full SwOS reads on the CSS318 - dialect keys, speed and uptime, VLAN members, empty factory password. Target files: src/adapter/swos-client.ts, src/adapter/swos-protocol.ts, src/cli/doctor.ts. Part one of #106, split out of #107 as asked: the read fixes for full SwOS (CSS318 on 2.19), rebased on `main` (1.13.2), without the new tools. (Ref: https://github.com/AliKarami/MikroMCP/pull/111)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ssh): report a host key mismatch as SSH_HOST_KEY_MISMATCH with both fingerprints. Target files: src/adapter/sftp-client.ts, src/adapter/ssh-client.ts, src/adapter/ssh-host-key.ts. (reported by @akuzin87). (Ref: https://github.com/AliKarami/MikroMCP/pull/104)

(Ref: https://github.com/AliKarami/MikroMCP/pull/91)

workarounds.symptom: torch always times out and traceroute repeats hops on RouterOS 7
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(diagnostics)!: run traceroute and torch over the REST API. Target files: site/src/data/content.ts, src/adapter/circuit-breaker.ts, src/adapter/response-parser.ts. - **`torch`** failed on every call with `ROUTER_UNREACHABLE: SSH command timed out …`. It ran `/tool torch` over SSH without a `duration` and relied on the SSH timeout, which discards the collected output. (Ref: https://github.com/AliKarami/MikroMCP/pull/84)
